# Where did your first Dopbase setup feel confusing?

If you have tried Dopbase, tell us how the first setup went.

What were you trying to do? Where did you pause, get an error, or need to check the docs?

Installation, first sign-in, importing `.env`, and choosing an environment are useful places to start. Tell us what worked well too.

Include your version and operating system when they help explain the problem. Redact credentials and private URLs from any error output.
